title.narrative: Enhancing freedom and safety of scientist and scientific research in the Hispanic Caribbean

description.narrative: The Natural Sciences and Social and Human Sciences programmes work together to ensure the freedom and safety of scientists and scientific researchers. Both Programmes emphasize the creation of normative frameworks, advocacy, and policy engagement to safeguard academic freedom and protect researchers from undue pressures. The Communication and Information program experience in Freedom of expression and safety of journalism will also contribute to the activities. In Cuba and Venezuela, scientists and scientific research are affected by long term crisis situation, leading to significant obstacles in sustaining their research and contributing to urgent solutions needed in these countries. Limited access to funding, functional and innovative facilities, and laboratories, along with disruptions to collaborative networks, severely hinder scientific progress when it is needed most.
